verdict.rationale: Ramp ships event-triggered automations: dynamic approval routing, auto top-up with target-balance rules and low-balance alerts, automatic hotel rebooking on price drops, and a customizable human-in-the-loop policy that auto-approves routine agent spend. For custom event-driven actions, though, the docs point users to webhooks plus their own handler service (Lambda, Cloud Run, etc.), so arbitrary rule-to-action logic needs external infrastructure. missing for 10: a documented first-party user-defined rule/trigger builder (if-event-then-action) inside Ramp, details of configurable trigger conditions and action types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
